title: Easy Crispy Turkish Lentils Mercimek Corbasi
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish featuring crispy fermented lentils and dark soft brown sugar, infused with oil and a dash of friendly spices, served in a mercimek corbasi form.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Drain and rinse the lentils again, then transfer them to a large pot.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Pour in the infuse oil and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the dark soft brown sugar and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Use a spoon to scoop out small amounts of the lentil mixture and shape into patties.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat and fry the lentil patties until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the crispy lentil patties hot and enjoy.
